ftest.title: Pruebas Funcionales
ftest.subtitle: Realice cada prueba siguiendo las instrucciones e informe si hubo dolor o molestia.
ftest.question: ¿Cómo fue la prueba?
ftest.no_tests_desc: No se encontraron pruebas específicas para las regiones seleccionadas.
ftest.cervical_rotation.name: Cervical Rotation
ftest.cervical_rotation.instruction: Seated with good posture, slowly rotate your head to the right and then to the left, trying to bring your chin toward your shoulder. Note any pain, limitation, or difference between sides.
ftest.cervical_flexion.name: Cervical Flexion & Extension
ftest.cervical_flexion.instruction: Seated, bring your chin toward your chest (flexion) then look up at the ceiling (extension). Perform slowly and note any pain or limitation.
ftest.upper_trap_stretch.name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
ftest.upper_trap_stretch.instruction: Seated, tilt your head to the right bringing your ear toward your shoulder. Hold 15 seconds. Repeat on the other side. Note excessive tension or pain.
ftest.deep_neck_flexor.name: Deep Neck Flexor Test
ftest.deep_neck_flexor.instruction: Lying face up, perform a gentle chin tuck and try to lift your head 2cm off the surface. Hold 10 seconds. Note tremor or difficulty.
ftest.cervical_trigger_points.name: Cervical Trigger Points
ftest.cervical_trigger_points.instructio: Using a tennis ball against the wall, press the lateral neck and base of skull area. Hold pressure for 20 seconds on tender points. Note if pain radiates elsewhere.
ftest.shoulder_flexion.name: Shoulder Flexion
ftest.shoulder_flexion.instruction: Standing, raise your arm in front of your body overhead. Keep the arm straight. Note at which angle pain or limitation appears.
ftest.shoulder_rotation.name: Shoulder Rotation
ftest.shoulder_rotation.instruction: With elbow at 90° and tucked to your side, rotate your forearm outward (external rotation) then bring your hand behind your back (internal rotation). Compare both sides.
ftest.pec_stretch.name: Pectoral Stretch
ftest.pec_stretch.instruction: Standing next to a doorway, place your forearm on the frame with elbow at shoulder height. Rotate your body away. Hold 20 seconds. Note tension or pain in chest/shoulder.
ftest.shoulder_isometric.name: Shoulder Isometric Test
ftest.shoulder_isometric.instruction: With elbow at 90° tucked to side, push your hand against a wall outward (external rotation). Hold 10 seconds. Repeat pushing inward. Note pain or weakness.
ftest.scapular_stability.name: Scapular Stability
ftest.scapular_stability.instruction: Perform a wall push-up. Observe if your shoulder blades wing out or protrude from your back. Note asymmetry between sides.
ftest.thoracic_rotation.name: Thoracic Rotation
ftest.thoracic_rotation.instruction: Seated with arms crossed on chest, rotate your trunk right then left. Keep hips still. Note limitation or pain.
ftest.thoracic_extension.name: Thoracic Extension
ftest.thoracic_extension.instruction: Seated with hands behind head, arch your back over the chair backrest. Move slowly. Note stiffness or pain in the mid-back region.
ftest.lumbar_flexion.name: Lumbar Flexion
ftest.lumbar_flexion.instruction: Standing, bend forward trying to touch your toes without bending your knees. Note where pain appears and how far you can reach.
ftest.lumbar_extension.name: Lumbar Extension
ftest.lumbar_extension.instruction: Standing with hands on hips, arch your back backward. Move slowly. Note if it worsens or relieves your lower back pain.
ftest.hamstring_flexibility.name: Hamstring Flexibility
ftest.hamstring_flexibility.instruction: Lying face up, raise one straight leg toward the ceiling. Keep the other leg on the floor. Note the angle reached and any pain behind the thigh.
ftest.core_endurance.name: Core Endurance
ftest.core_endurance.instruction: Lying face up with knees bent, lift your head and shoulders off the floor while pressing your lower back down. Hold 30 seconds. Note tremor or inability to maintain.
ftest.single_leg_balance.name: Single Leg Balance
ftest.single_leg_balance.instruction: Standing, lift one foot off the ground and maintain balance for 30 seconds. Repeat on the other side. Note instability or pain.
ftest.slump_test.name: Slump Test
ftest.slump_test.instruction: Seated on edge of chair, slouch forward and bring chin to chest. Then straighten one knee. Note if pain radiates down the leg (may indicate neural tension).
ftest.mckenzie_extension.name: McKenzie Extension
ftest.mckenzie_extension.instruction: Lying face down, prop up on elbows then hands, arching your back. Hold 5 seconds and repeat 10 times. Note if pain centralizes (improves) or peripheralizes (worsens).
ftest.lumbar_trigger_points.name: Lumbar Trigger Points
ftest.lumbar_trigger_points.instruction: Lying down, place a tennis ball under your lower back and glutes. Roll slowly seeking tender points. Hold pressure 20-30 seconds per point. Note referred pain.
ftest.hip_flexion.name: Hip Flexion
ftest.hip_flexion.instruction: Lying face up, pull one knee toward your chest with hands. Note limitation or pain in the groin/hip. Compare both sides.
ftest.hip_rotation.name: Hip Rotation
ftest.hip_rotation.instruction: Lying with knees bent at 90°, let leg fall inward (internal rotation) and outward (external rotation). Note pain or limitation in each direction.
ftest.hip_flexor_stretch.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
ftest.hip_flexor_stretch.instruction: Kneel with one knee on the ground and other foot forward. Push hips forward keeping trunk upright. Hold 20 seconds. Note tension in front of thigh/hip.
ftest.glute_bridge.name: Glute Bridge
ftest.glute_bridge.instruction: Lying face up with knees bent, lift hips off floor squeezing glutes. Hold 10 seconds. Note weakness, asymmetry, or pain.
ftest.knee_flexion_extension.name: Knee Flexion & Extension
ftest.knee_flexion_extension.instruction: Seated, fully extend your knee then bend it as far as possible. Note crepitus (clicking), pain, or limitation of motion.
ftest.quad_flexibility.name: Quadriceps Flexibility
ftest.quad_flexibility.instruction: Standing, hold your ankle and pull heel toward glute. Hold 20 seconds. Note excessive tension or pain in front of thigh.
ftest.single_leg_squat.name: Single Leg Squat
ftest.single_leg_squat.instruction: Standing on one leg, squat slowly to 45°. Note if knee caves inward, if there's pain or instability. Compare both sides.
ftest.knee_stability.name: Knee Stability
ftest.knee_stability.instruction: Standing on one leg, perform small knee bends (mini squats). Note if knee wobbles side to side or if there's a feeling of giving way.
ftest.single_leg_balance_ankle.name: Single Leg Balance (30 seconds)
ftest.single_leg_balance_ankle.instructi: Standing, lift one foot off the ground and maintain balance for 30 seconds. Repeat on the other side. Compare stability between sides. Note instability, swaying, or inability to complete the 30 seconds.
ftest.weight_bearing_lunge_test.name: Weight-Bearing Lunge Test
ftest.weight_bearing_lunge_test.instruct: Standing facing a wall with the test foot forward. Lunge your knee toward the wall without lifting the heel. Progressively move the foot back until you find the maximum distance where the knee still touches the wall. Measure the distance from big toe to wall. Compare both sides — differences greater than 1.5cm may be significant.
ftest.heel_rise_test.name: Heel Rise Test
ftest.heel_rise_test.instruction: Standing on one leg with hand lightly resting on a wall for balance, rise onto tiptoe as high as possible and lower slowly. Repeat until fatigue or up to 25 reps. Count repetitions on each side and compare. Fewer than 20 reps may indicate triceps surae weakness.
ftest.questionnaire_overlap_notice: Algunos movimientos que ya fueron abordados en el cuestionario pueden solicitarse nuevamente. Esto es normal — las pruebas funcionales evalúan aspectos diferentes.
ftest.wrist_flexion_extension.name: Wrist Flexion & Extension
ftest.wrist_flexion_extension.instructio: With forearm supported, bend your wrist up and down fully. Note pain, limitation, or difference between hands.
ftest.grip_strength.name: Grip Strength
ftest.grip_strength.instruction: Squeeze a rolled towel with maximum force for 10 seconds. Note pain in wrist, elbow, or forearm. Compare both hands.
ftest.neural_tension_upper.name: Upper Limb Neural Tension
ftest.neural_tension_upper.instruction: Standing, extend arm to the side at shoulder height palm up. Extend wrist (fingers pointing down) and tilt head to the opposite side. Note tingling or pain radiating down the arm.

faq.title: Preguntas Frecuentes
faq.faq1.q: ¿Qué es esta evaluación y cómo funciona?
faq.faq1.a: Es una evaluación musculoesquelética online, formulada por un fisioterapeuta especialista, que le guía con preguntas sobre su dolor, pruebas funcionales y genera una hipótesis diagnóstica con plan de tratamiento personalizado.
faq.faq2.q: ¿Por qué debo invertir en la evaluación premium?
faq.faq2.a: La versión premium incluye anamnesis completa, pruebas funcionales con video, cuestionarios validados científicamente, diagnóstico detallado con explicación, plan de tratamiento en 3 fases con ejercicios e informe en PDF.
faq.faq3.a: La evaluación fue formulada por un fisioterapeuta especializado en Traumatología-Ortopedia y Fisioterapia Deportiva, con posgrado en el área y más de 7 años de experiencia clínica.
faq.faq4.a: No. La evaluación es una herramienta de triaje y orientación. Ayuda a entender su dolor y direccionar el tratamiento, pero no sustituye el diagnóstico médico o fisioterapéutico presencial.
faq.faq5.a: ¡Sí! En la versión premium, puede repetir la evaluación una vez en hasta 7 días después de la compra.
faq.faq6.q: ¿Y si el triaje identifica señales de alerta (banderas rojas)?
faq.faq6.a: El triaje de seguridad es parte integral de toda evaluación. Si se detectan señales como trauma grave, pérdida de peso inexplicada o entumecimiento progresivo, la evaluación se concluye en ese punto y se recomienda evaluación médica presencial.

gateway.about_text: Aliv.iA nació de la inquietud de Guilherme, fisioterapeuta carioca, al observar la cantidad de orientaciones sin fundamento y sin ningún triaje o evaluación adecuada circulando por internet. Con la misión de cambiar esa realidad, idealizó y construyó Aliv.iA — una plataforma que combina inteligencia artificial y razonamiento clínico para ayudar en dos frentes: personas que buscan resolver sus dolores con más seguridad y base científica, y fisioterapeutas que desean llegar más preparados a sus evaluaciones, con informes de evolución que agregan valor real a la atención. Todo esto con precio justo y accesible.

support.patient.tool.basic_assessment.de: The basic assessment is free and allows you to complete a guided questionnaire about your pain. Every assessment includes an integrated safety screening (red flags) — if warning signs are detected, the assessment is concluded at that point and medical referral is recommended. At the end, you receive a summary result with the questionnaire score. To start, go to the dashboard and click 'New Assessment' → 'Basic'. No payment required.
The premium assessment includes detailed anamnesis, red flag screening, validated questionnaires, pain map, functional tests, and an AI-generated preliminary diagnosis with a personalized treatment plan. The safety screening is an integral part of the assessment — if red flags are identified, the assessment is considered completed and in-person medical referral is essential. Requires an active monthly subscription or single payment.
support.patient.tool.premium_status.desc: At the top of the dashboard, you can see your subscription status: remaining days, available assessments for the month, and a button to manage or upgrade. Monthly subscribers can perform up to 2 premium assessments per month.
support.patient.tool.pain_diary.title: Pain Diary
support.patient.tool.pain_diary.desc: Record your pain daily to track progress over time. Simply click 'Log Pain', choose a score from 0 to 10, and optionally add notes. The chart shows your pain trend over the last few days. We recommend recording at least once a day.
support.patient.tool.comparison.title: Assessment Comparison
support.patient.tool.comparison.desc: When you have more than one completed assessment, the system allows side-by-side comparison. Select two assessments to see the evolution of functional subscales and overall score, checking for improvement or decline.
support.patient.tool.history.title: Assessment History
support.patient.tool.history.desc: All your assessments are available in the 'My Assessments' section. Click any assessment to view full details, including diagnosis, treatment plan, and the option to download the report as PDF.
support.patient.tool.find_professional.d: After completing an assessment, the platform may suggest registered physiotherapists in your area. You can also access the search from the 'Professionals' menu. A convenient way to find in-person care.
support.patient.tool.referral_code.title: Referral Code
support.patient.tool.referral_code.desc: Each user has a unique referral code. Share it with friends, and when they sign up and use the platform, you may receive discounts on future assessments. Your code is available on the dashboard.
support.patient.tool.profile_language.de: In the top menu, you can switch between Portuguese and English by clicking the language button. To edit personal data such as name, age, and gender, go to the profile section on the dashboard.
support.patient.tool.messages.title: Messages with Professional
support.patient.tool.messages.desc: After finding a physiotherapist through the professional search, you can send a direct message. Conversations are available in the 'Messages' tab on your dashboard. Use it to ask questions, schedule appointments, or discuss your case before an in-person visit.
support.patient.faq.pf1.q: Can I do more than one assessment?
support.patient.faq.pf1.a: Yes! Monthly subscribers can perform up to 2 premium assessments per month. Single-payment users get 1 assessment per purchase. Basic assessments are unlimited and free.
support.patient.faq.pf2.a: Yes. All data is stored with encryption and restricted to your account. No data is shared with third parties without your consent.
support.patient.faq.pf3.q: Do I still need to see a doctor after the assessment?
support.patient.faq.pf3.a: Aliv.iA's assessment is an evidence-based preliminary screening, but it does not replace an in-person consultation. If red flags are identified, the platform recommends urgent in-person care.
support.patient.faq.pf4.q: How does the treatment plan work?
support.patient.faq.pf4.a: Upon completing a premium assessment, the AI generates a personalized treatment plan with exercises, guidance, and recommendations based on your responses and preliminary diagnosis.
support.patient.faq.pf5.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
support.patient.faq.pf5.a: Yes. Go to the dashboard, click 'Manage subscription' and you'll be redirected to the payment portal where you can cancel anytime. Access remains active until the end of the paid period.
support.patient.faq.pf6.q: What happens if I have red flags?
support.patient.faq.pf6.a: The red flag screening is an integral part of every assessment, not a separate step. If symptoms such as severe trauma, unexplained weight loss, relentless night pain, or progressive numbness are detected, the assessment is concluded at that point — and is considered a completed assessment. Referral to a physician for in-person investigation is an essential health prerogative. Your safety is always the priority.
support.patient.faq.pf7.a: Yes. You can start a new assessment at any time within your plan limits. Previous assessment history remains saved for comparison.
support.patient.faq.pf8.a: No, it's optional. However, keeping a daily pain log helps identify patterns and track progress, making future assessments more accurate.
support.pro.tool.custom_link.title: Personalized Assessment Link
support.pro.tool.custom_link.desc: At the top of your professional panel, you'll find your exclusive link. Copy and send it to patients via WhatsApp, email, or message. When the patient completes the assessment, it appears automatically in your panel.
support.pro.tool.statistics.title: General Statistics
support.pro.tool.statistics.desc: Statistics cards show the total assessments performed by your patients and how many were completed in the current month, allowing you to track your clinical practice volume.
support.pro.tool.analytics_charts.title: Analytics Charts
support.pro.tool.analytics_charts.desc: View assessment distribution by status (completed, in progress, pending) in a donut chart, and most frequent pain regions among your patients in a bar chart. This data helps identify clinical patterns.
support.pro.tool.patient_list.title: Patient List
support.pro.tool.patient_list.desc: All patients who completed an assessment via your link are listed with name or email search. Click a patient to expand and see all their assessments with date, type, and status.
support.pro.tool.evolution_dashboard.des: When selecting a patient with more than one assessment, the dashboard shows comparative charts of the top 3 functional limitation subscales and total score over time. Ideal for demonstrating clinical progress.
support.pro.tool.pdf_download.title: PDF Report Download
support.pro.tool.pdf_download.desc: Each completed assessment can be exported as a PDF containing assessment data, diagnosis, treatment plan, and your professional notes. Use for clinical documentation or patient sharing.
support.pro.tool.pro_notes.title: Professional Notes
support.pro.tool.pro_notes.desc: Each patient assessment has a private notes field for clinical observations. These notes are visible only to you and are included in exported PDFs.
support.pro.tool.pro_subscription.title: PRO Subscription
support.pro.tool.pro_subscription.desc: The PRO plan unlocks full access to the professional panel. Choose monthly or annual subscription. Manage your subscription, change plans, or cancel via 'Manage subscription' in the panel.
support.pro.tool.edit_profile.title: Edit Professional Profile
support.pro.tool.edit_profile.desc: Keep your data updated: name, CREFITO, specialties, city, clinic address, and profile photo. This information is displayed to patients in the professional search.
support.pro.tool.lifetime_treatment.desc: With Lifetime Treatment, all your patients' treatment plans are permanently unlocked — no additional cost per assessment, from the purchase date onward. Important: access to the professional panel still requires an active PRO subscription (monthly or annual). Lifetime Treatment does not replace the panel subscription.
support.pro.tool.messages.title: Messages with Patients
support.pro.tool.messages.desc: Patients who found you through the professional search can send direct messages. Conversations appear in the 'Messages' tab of your professional panel. Answer questions, schedule appointments, and strengthen the bond with your patients even before an in-person visit.
support.pro.faq.rf1.q: Does my patient need to create an Aliv.iA account?
support.pro.faq.rf1.a: Not necessarily. Using your personalized link, the patient can complete the assessment and the result is linked to your panel. However, if they want to access their history later, they'll need to create an account.
support.pro.faq.rf2.q: How do I cancel my PRO subscription?
support.pro.faq.rf2.a: Access your professional panel, click 'Manage subscription' and you'll be directed to the secure payment portal where you can cancel at any time. Access remains active until the end of the paid period.
support.pro.faq.rf3.a: Yes. The platform uses encryption and restricted access policies. Only you have access to assessments linked to your profile. Data follows security and privacy best practices.
support.pro.faq.rf4.q: Can I use Aliv.iA as a pre-consultation screening tool?
support.pro.faq.rf4.a: Yes, that's one of the main use cases. Send the link to the patient before the appointment so they complete the assessment. During the consultation, you'll already have anamnesis, questionnaires, and pain map filled in.
support.pro.faq.rf5.q: How many patients can I manage with the PRO plan?
support.pro.faq.rf5.a: There is no patient limit. All patients who complete an assessment via your link will appear in your panel automatically.
support.pro.faq.rf6.q: What does the patient evolution chart show?
support.pro.faq.rf6.a: The chart shows the top 3 functional limitation subscales and total questionnaire score, comparing all assessments over time. This makes it easy to visually demonstrate clinical progress.
support.pro.faq.rf7.q: Can I export all patient data?
support.pro.faq.rf7.a: Yes. Use the 'Export PDFs' button to generate batch reports of all assessments with completed diagnoses. Each assessment generates an individual PDF.
support.pro.faq.rf8.q: Are the notes I add visible to the patient?
support.pro.faq.rf8.a: No. Professional notes are private and visible only to you in the panel. They are included in the exported PDF for clinical documentation purposes.
